blurb: Laguna Madre Anglers offers guided fishing trips, duck hunting trips, and sunset cruises in Corpus Christi Bay, Laguna Madre, Baffin Bay, and Land Cut. Guests can fish for species like red fish, trout, red snapper, flounder, and drum, or enjoy sightseeing and dolphin watching. Trips include gear and cleaning of catch; guests must bring licenses and personal items.
